description: NaNd(GaSe₂)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fddd space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.18-3.33 Å. There are two inequivalent Nd sites. In the first Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight Se atoms. There are four shorter (3.13 Å) and four longer (3.16 Å) Nd-Se bond lengths. In the second Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight Se atoms. There are four shorter (3.14 Å) and four longer (3.15 Å) Nd-Se bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded to four Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing GaSe₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (2.42 Å) and three longer (2.46 Å) Ga-Se bond lengths. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded to four Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing GaSe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ga-Se bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.47 Å. There are four inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to one Na, one Nd, and two equivalent Ga atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNaNdGa₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Nd, and two equivalent Ga atoms. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to one Na, one Nd, and two Ga atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNaNdGa₂ trigonal pyramids. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to one Na, one Nd, and two Ga atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNaNdGa₂ trigonal pyramids.
